finding: V10 replay rehydration must not blindly reserve persisted account_id after restart. ForegroundAccountReservations accepts any account_id and wait_for_turn_route compares the count of reserved IDs to account_pool.size without checking pool membership. If the persisted owner account was removed/replaced/invalidated between runs, rehydrating that stale ID can make unrelated work wait until the 300s reservation TTL despite all currently configured accounts being free.
required_core_invariant: Before post-restart reservation rehydration, prove persisted account_id is a currently configured pool member.
If the persisted account is absent, do not create a ghost reservation.

Do not silently route the same persisted tool-call continuation through a different account/thread. Fail closed for that replay unless the Agent lane supplies an explicitly proven safe full-history rebase contract.
A persisted final response may still clear the turn reservation regardless of account membership.
boundary: This finding does not change rotation/failover policy. It only constrains Core crash-recovery rehydration so stale durable account identities cannot poison live capacity or silently move an unfinished tool chain to another account.
